Market today: The mood is cautious for tech/chip names. Rising longer-dated Treasury yields and concerns about AI data center stocks being among the week's worst are the real drivers, directly impacting your concentrated portfolio.

Your holdings: SOXL (-52.84%) and SPAL (-43.4%) are in deep drawdowns and are leveraged, meaning drops hurt extra on margin. SMH (-11.96%) and QQQI (-3.95%) also show losses and are flagged for trimming.

Watch: Keep a close eye on Treasury yields and any further weakness in the AI/data center sector. Also, monitor the looming Trump tariff deadline for broader market volatility.

Bottom line: Prioritize aggressive risk management on your leveraged and losing positions given the current market signals.
plays: Respect SOXL's stop at 200; its leveraged nature and decay amplify losses, especially on margin.
Monitor SPAL closely; its -43.4% loss and leveraged structure demand strict adherence to its 21.38 stop.
Consider trimming CRWD to lock in gains, especially with its 147.5 stop far below current price.
